fl-pk-01.front: What decides pack size: height or torso length?
fl-pk-01.diagram:

<circle cx="30" cy="32" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="30" y="39" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="56" y="39" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Measure between</text>

</svg>

fl-pk-02.front: Torso length runs from where to where?
fl-pk-02.back: From the bony bump at the base of the neck to a line between your thumbs on top of your hip bones (70%).
fl-pk-02.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="Put your hands on the top of your hip bones, thumbs pointing to your spine. A line between your thumbs is the bottom of your torso length.">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<circle cx="30" cy="32" r="17" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="30" y="39" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="56" y="39" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Find the hip bones</text>
<circle cx="200" cy="82" r="20" fill="#e9c9a8" stroke="#6b4f35" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="140" y="104" width="120" height="140" rx="30" fill="#e9c9a8" stroke="#6b4f35" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="200" y1="104" x2="200" y2="240" stroke="#6b4f35" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/><rect x="126" y="200" width="40" height="18" rx="6" fill="#e8590c"/><rect x="234" y="200" width="40" height="18" rx="6" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="166" y1="209" x2="234" y2="209" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/><text x="336" y="196" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">Thumb line</text>

</svg>

fl-pk-03.back: Centred on top of your hip bones (the iliac crest) (70%).

fl-pk-13.front: Five lifting steps (BC Forest Safety Council)?
fl-pk-13.back: Size it up, firm footing and grip, bend knees and brace, load close and lift with legs, turn with your feet (85%).

fl-pk-15.front: Getting up with a heavy pack from the ground?
fl-pk-15.back: Sit into it, buckle the hip belt, roll to a knee, push up on the front knee, stand (Tip).

fl-pk-16.front: Rifle in or on a vehicle with a full attached magazine?
fl-pk-16.back: Unlawful. No live round in the breech or attached magazine in or on a vehicle (99%, item 28).
